The activity panel can now show what each agent did, not only the main conversation's calls.

- Click an agent under Agents in `/desk-activity` to unfold its own calls below it: reads and searches folded into one line, edits with `+N −M`, commands with their result and time, in the same form as the flow. Click it again to fold it. `View transcript` at the end of the row opens the agent in `/desk-tasks`
- A pane opened from a button in another pane (an agent's `View transcript`, the progress band) now comes to the front. Before, while you held the pane you clicked in, Claude Code kept the new pane behind it as a tab

## Install

```
/plugin install desk-look --marketplace KyongSik-Yoon/cc-desktop-mod
/plugin install desk-asana@cc-desktop-mod
/plugin install desk-slack@cc-desktop-mod
```

Already installed: `/desk-update` (or `claude plugin update desk-look`), then `/reload-plugins`.
